signature.name: Badshahi Mosque
signature.detail: One of the world's largest Mughal mosques, with a vast courtyard and intricate red sandstone and marble detail. Visit early morning or late afternoon for softer light and fewer crowds; modest dress required and shoes removed at the entrance.

signature.name: Lahore Fort
signature.detail: A UNESCO-listed fortress with the Sheesh Mahal (Palace of Mirrors), Naulakha Pavilion and royal gardens. Go early to avoid heat; tickets are separate for fort and mosque, and a combined ticket saves time.

signature.name: Minar-e-Pakistan
signature.detail: A towering monument marking the 1940 Lahore Resolution, set in a large park. Best at sunset when the tower is lit; take a rickshaw or taxi to the Iqbal Park entrance.

signature.name: Shalimar Gardens
signature.detail: A UNESCO-listed Mughal garden with terraced lawns, fountains and pavilions. Visit in the cooler morning hours; entry fee is modest and the site is a short taxi ride from the old city.

transport: Rickshaw short trip $1-2; taxi app $3-5 across town
